items.question: How do I change the language?
items.answer: Go to Settings, select 'Language', and choose between Indonesian or English. The app will update immediately.

items.question: How to enable Dark Mode?
items.answer: Open Settings > Appearance. You can choose 'Light', 'Dark', or 'System' to match your device settings.

items.question: How do I record income/expense?
items.answer: Tap the (+) button on the home screen, select transaction type, enter amount, choose category, and tap Save.

items.question: Can I change the currency?
items.answer: Yes, you can change the currency (IDR, USD, etc.) via Settings > Currency.

items.question: What is the Transfer feature?
items.answer: Transfer is used to move balance between your Wallets, e.g., from 'Cash' to 'Bank Account', ensuring accurate records.

items.question: How to enable daily reminders?
items.answer: Enable 'Daily Reminder' in Settings. You can set a specific time for the app to remind you to record transactions.

items.question: I forgot my password, how to reset?
items.answer: On the Login screen, click 'Forgot Password'. Enter your email, and we will send a link to create a new password.

items.question: Will I lose data if I change phone?
items.answer: No. Your data is securely stored in the cloud. Just login with the same email on your new device, and your data will sync.

items.question: How to delete my account?
items.answer: Warning: This is permanent. Go to Settings > Security > Delete Account. All your transaction data will be erased forever.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: At CashFlowly, we value your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information when you use our mobile application.

sections.title: 1. Information We Collect
sections.content:
We collect data essential for app functionality:

(a) Personal Data: Name, email, and profile photo (avatar) for account identity.
(b) Financial Data: Transaction history, categories, and wallet data you voluntarily input.
(c) Technical Data: Notification tokens (Expo Push Token) for reminders, and device data for debugging.
(d) Support Data: Message content and file attachments uploaded when contacting customer support.

sections.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
sections.content:
Your data is used to:
• Store and sync financial records across devices in real-time.
• Send Local Notifications (Daily Reminders) and Push Notifications regarding your account.
• Process support tickets and review issue attachments.
• Customize the app appearance based on your Language and Theme preferences.

sections.title: 3. Data Storage & Security
sections.content: We use Supabase as our secure backend provider. Your data is protected with SSL/TLS encryption during transit. We implement Row Level Security (RLS) on our database, ensuring your transactions and support tickets are accessible only by your own account.

sections.title: 4. Third-Party Services
sections.content:
For app operations, we use trusted services:
• Supabase: For database, authentication, and file storage.
• Expo: For notification infrastructure.
We do not sell your personal data to third parties for marketing purposes.

sections.title: 5. Device Permissions
sections.content:
The app may request access to:
• Gallery/Storage: To upload avatars or support ticket attachments.
• Notifications: To display the daily reminders you scheduled.

sections.title: 6. Your Rights & Control
sections.content: You have full control. You can update your profile, reset data, or permanently delete your account via Settings > Security > Delete Account. Account deletion will erase all your transaction data from our servers.

sections.title: 7. Policy Changes
sections.content: We may update this policy as we add new features. Significant changes will be communicated via app notifications.

sections.title: 8. Contact Us
sections.content: If you have privacy-related questions, please contact us via the 'Help & Support' feature in the app or email support@cashflowly.app.
